name: Review Diagnostics
description: Publishes open review-finding subtasks as VS Code diagnostics. mcp-core task-format.parseFindingLocation extracts the first path:line[:col] (also ranges, #L anchors, Windows drive paths) from the finding description. extension/src/reviewDiagnostics.ts: pure findingDiagnostics(tasks, resolveRoot) maps open findings of live root tasks (severity from priority: high=error, medium=warning, low=info; skips done, unlocated) and registerReviewDiagnostics owns a DiagnosticCollection refreshed (300 ms debounce) from refreshTaskSurfaces in extension.ts. Relative paths resolve against the parent task's worktree (unassigned → active worktree). Quick fixes keyed by the diagnostic's short task-id code: "Open finding on task board" (codeWorkbench.tasks.openTaskInPage on the parent) and "Mark finding done" (codeWorkbench.reviewDiagnostics.markDone → task-store). Toggle: codeWorkbench.reviewDiagnostics.enabled.
guidelines: Keep the task→diagnostic mapping pure; only the collection/code-action wiring touches vscode.
Do not reference vscode enums at module scope (the test stub lacks them).
anti_patterns: Do not parse finding locations ad hoc elsewhere — use parseFindingLocation.
